doc.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025

title: Answering 'what do you do?' and 'is that your real job?'
summary: Bennett says he simply calls himself a touring musician and feels blessed to have supported himself throughout.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: If you went to a gathering, a cocktail party or something and you didn’t really know anybody and you met a new person and they say, “Well what do you do for a living, Dave?” Do you have a short answer?
I just say, “I’m a musician, a touring musician.”
Yeah. Have you ever had anybody say, “What’s your real job then?”

Yeah. Yeah. A lot of people would say that if they don’t know. I mean I’ve been really blessed my entire life. I don’t — blessing is the only way I could say it because on paper it makes no sense. I’ve been afforded great opportunities, you know, more than most. And I don’t like to — if someone asks I’ll talk about it but it’s not something that I, you know, — so yeah people would say to me, “Is that your real job.” I say, “Yeah, yeah. I’ve supported myself my whole life and just leave it at that. I mean you don’t need to blow a trumpet and talk about your — at least for me you don’t need to talk about yourself and do that whole thing.
